texts.summary: Cardinal Giovanni Salviati, 16 October 1525, to a recipient Lasry leaves not established. Salviati discusses restoration of possession and imperial territory, defence and government of the state, nobles and people, captains and guards, the archbishop of Toledo, Modena, and correspondence sent by land and sea.
texts.note: The repository holds only the excerpt and translation in George Lasry's report (lasry_entry.md); his full transcription and decryption are his and not yet in the repository, and the ciphertext has not been transcribed here.

His decryption of the rest (3/8 pages in part) is not in the repository and is not graded here.
